title.en: Lido DAO: who can vote, and what can stop a vote
title.zh: Lido DAO：谁能投票，什么能拦下投票

subtitle.en: Lido runs liquid staking for Ethereum. Here are its voting rules, and 161 published audits that were never reconciled with each other.
subtitle.zh: Lido 做的是以太坊的质押（stETH）。这里是它的投票规则，以及 161 份彼此从未对账过的公开审计。

title.en: Anyone holding 1,000 LDO can open a vote
title.zh: 持有 1,000 LDO 就能发起一次投票

claims.claim: To create a proposal on the Lido DAO Snapshot, users need at least 1,000 LDO tokens

ev.text: To create a proposal on the Lido DAO Snapshot, users need at least 1,000 LDO tokens — a minimum threshold that deters spam proposals. To pass, a proposal requires the winning option to receive both a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority of all participating tokens.
ev.hl: To create a proposal on the Lido DAO Snapshot, users need at least 1,000 LDO tokens

claims.verify: open lido.fi/governance → "Regular process" → "Off-chain voting", first paragraph
claims.after: On-chain voting — To pass, a proposal requires the "yes" option to receive both a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority of all participating tokens.

title.en: A proposal passes only at 5% of all LDO voting yes. The docs never say how much LDO exists.
title.zh: 提案要 5% 的 LDO 投赞成才通过——而文档全文没有说 LDO 总共有多少

claims.claim: a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority

ev.text: To create a proposal on the Lido DAO Snapshot, users need at least 1,000 LDO tokens — a minimum threshold that deters spam proposals. To pass, a proposal requires the winning option to receive both a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority of all participating tokens.
ev.hl: a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority

claims.verify: open lido.fi/governance → "Regular process" → "Off-chain voting", first paragraph
claims.after: On-chain voting — To pass, a proposal requires the "yes" option to receive both a minimum of 5% of total LDO token supply and a simple majority of all participating tokens.

title.en: stETH holders can freeze a Lido decision for up to 45 days by escrowing 1% of stETH
title.zh: stETH 持有者质押 1% 的 stETH 就能把治理决议冻结 5 到 45 天

claims.claim: Veto Signaling is activated with >1% of the total stETH supply
claims.section: Dual Governance: Veto Signaling and Rage Quit

ev.text: Veto Signaling is activated with >1% of the total stETH supply in the signaling escrow. This blocks governance motions for 5 to 45 days, depending on the amount of opposing tokens. This provides time for negotiation between LDO and stETH holders.
ev.hl: Veto Signaling is activated with >1% of the total stETH supply

claims.verify: open lido.fi/governance → expand "Dual Governance: Veto Signaling and Rage Quit", first paragraph
claims.before: Dual Governance: stETH holders challenge window — After passing the vote, on-chain actions targeting Lido on Ethereum protocol enter Dual Governance — a dynamic timelock that allows stETH holders to extend execution delay based on the level of opposition.
claims.after: Rage Quit is triggered when >10% of the total stETH supply is locked in the signaling escrow. Governance stays paused until opposing stakers exit the protocol.

title.en: At 10% of stETH escrowed, governance stops until those stakers leave the protocol
title.zh: 一旦 10% 的 stETH 被锁进托管，治理就完全停摆，直到这些人退出

claims.claim: Rage Quit is triggered when >10% of the total stETH supply is locked in the signaling escrow
claims.section: Dual Governance: Veto Signaling and Rage Quit

ev.text: Rage Quit is triggered when >10% of the total stETH supply is locked in the signaling escrow. Governance stays paused until opposing stakers exit the protocol.
ev.hl: Rage Quit is triggered when >10% of the total stETH supply is locked

claims.before: Veto Signaling is activated with >1% of the total stETH supply in the signaling escrow. This blocks governance motions for 5 to 45 days, depending on the amount of opposing tokens.

title.en: Lido says it has more than 55,000 distinct LDO holders
title.zh: Lido 自称有 55,000 名以上独立的 LDO 持有者

claims.claim: With over 55,000 unique LDO token holders

ev.text: With over 55,000 unique LDO token holders, the Lido DAO stewards the protocol towards community and decentralization alignment. Additional safeguard for the protocol is provided by stETH holders via the Dual Governance system that allows them to delay contentious proposals before execution.
ev.hl: With over 55,000 unique LDO token holders

claims.before: The Lido Protocol operates under the oversight of the Lido DAO, a decentralized autonomous organization governed by LDO token holders.
claims.after: LDO — LDO is the Lido DAO's governance token. Built on the ERC-20 standard, it includes balance snapshotting functionality…

title.en: Lido has published 161 smart-contract audits between 2020 and 2026
title.zh: 2020 到 2026 年，Lido 一共公开了 161 份智能合约审计

title.en: 31 of those 161 audits give no issue count, so totals only work for the other 130
title.zh: 其中 31 份完全没有 issue 数字，所以总量只能对另外 130 份比较

claims.claim: 130 of 161 entries carry a Total Issues line

lines: 10-2021 Sigma Prime Easy Track Smart Contract Security Assessment
08-2022 MixBytes Lido Protocol Security Auditor's Review
ev.note: 无 Total Issues 行 → 无法与其余条目做总量对比

title.en: The bETH Vault audit summary says 5 issues. The list beneath it adds to 7, and every one is unfixed.
title.zh: bETH Vault 那份审计的总结写 5 个问题，下面列的加起来是 7 个，而且 7 个全部未修

claims.section: 01-2022 MixBytes bETH Vault Security Audit Report

ev.note: 分类合计 1+4+2 = 7 ≠ 总数 5；且三类全部 Acknowledged，与“3 Fixed”矛盾

title.en: The Chainlink CSR audit summary says 7 issues. The list beneath it adds to 6.
title.zh: Chainlink CSR 那份审计的总结写 7 个问题，下面列的加起来只有 6 个

claims.section: 02-2025 Trail of Bits Chainlink CSR Security Review

ev.note: 分类合计 1+2+3 = 6 ≠ 总数 7，少一条

title.en: One audit entry counts 'Notes' inside its total, another leaves them out
title.zh: 同一个「Notes」字段，一份审计算进总数，另一份不算

lines: - Total Issues: 9 (4 Risk accepted, 5 Acknowledged)   ← 08-2022 ChainSecurity
ev.note: 同一个字段名，两条目两种计数口径

q.en: When do the remaining LDO tokens unlock, and who holds them?
q.zh: 剩下的 LDO 什么时候解锁，在谁手里？

gaps.a: The provided evidence does not include the LDO token unlock schedule or vesting terms.

why.en: Lido's official docs never publish a distribution or unlock schedule.
why.zh: Lido 官方文档从不公布分配或解锁时间表

q.en: How many LDO exist in total?

gaps.a: The provided evidence does not specify a numeric total supply for LDO tokens.

why.en: The 5% quorum is defined against a number the docs never give.
why.zh: 5% 的通过门槛是对着一个文档从不给出的数字定义的

q.en: What do the 31 audits without issue counts contain?
q.zh: 没有 issue 数字的那 31 份审计，里面写了什么？

gaps.a: 31 / 161 entries carry no Total Issues line.

why.en: Issue totals can only be compared across 130 of the 161.
why.zh: 161 份里只有 130 份能比总量

q.en: Has anything marked 'Acknowledged' ever been fixed later?
q.zh: 标为「Acknowledged」的问题，后来修过吗？

gaps.a: The index has no field for whether a later audit resolved an earlier finding.

why.en: 98 audits carry acknowledged findings and the index has no follow-up field.
why.zh: 98 份带着未修项，而索引里没有跟进字段
